text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...... 'Connect.' 
That is—'difficult.'"

text_block_list.name: Passing Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Ah~... Feels like it's gonna rain. 
Still, it's such a pain to go back and get 
an umbrella..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —"NMBS" approaches.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"'Observed' expansion of "NMBS"... 'UMBR' 
is essential. 
Neo Universe can... 'provide.'"

text_block_list.name: Passing Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...Uhh~... Sorry, I'm in a rush! 
Rain, rain, go away—!!"
(SHHHHHHWWWWWOOOOOOOOO)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"—'Disconnect'... 
Yet Neo Universe has 'encountered' Sounds 
of Earth."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, amica! Were you also guided 
by the splendid stars!?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...The "panorama" here is "BRGT".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! It truly feels as if we are 
surrounded by a vast audience! 
My fingers playing the violin naturally 
grow appassionato!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, what is the matter? 
Why such a puzzled look?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"....... Are Neo Universe's 'words' 
...'connecting'?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, of course. You speak of the world in 
such beautiful words, don't you? 
They resonate so pleasantly in my ears, 
within my heart."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"It is wondrous. It feels as if I am 
conversing with a long-time friend—no, 
with family."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"....... 
Neo Universe and you—'synchronized.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe 'senses' it. 
Your 'melody' is also...'beautiful.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Around Sounds of Earth—'MSIC' never 
ceases. 
It brings 'tides' and 'excitation' to the 
hearts of others."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"With Neo Universe, it should be 'DAZT'... 
And yet—ever since we 'met,' I have felt a 
'connection.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Even in races, regardless of 
placement—Sounds of Earth's running 
brings 'resonance' and 'gain' to others, 
becoming 'MSIC.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Yes...'ensemble.' Constantly 'seeking' 
only that, 
Sounds of Earth 'does her best.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Always. Even now—in this very moment.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"'Performing' Earth. 'Running' Earth. 
'Striving' Earth."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Neo Universe wants to send... 
'CHER' to all of it."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Fukukitaru, 
the sponge cake is baked all the way 
through."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"All right~ Then as soon as it cools down 
a bit, 
let's remove it from the mold to let it 
finish cooling~!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sphera. Sponge cake—'all green.'

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right...! With everyone's power 
combined, this chocolate cake is complete! 
Now it's time for the finishing special 
move, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Earth! Hit it with your best shot, PLEASE!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! ――Super Deco-Combination! 
Duo! Ritmo della Terra!

text_block_list.name: Earth & Taiki
text_block_list.text: Bravissimo Double Duo Impact!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...A-And with that, concludes our 4th 
session, 
'How to Decorate.'

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that recording turned into 
absolute chaos once again, didn't it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's fine! Actually, the 
reception's been getting better with every 
episode. 
We've had comments like 'It made me want 
to make chocolates!' and 'I'm just gonna 
go for it and confess my feelings too!'

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
At this point... just run wild with it! 
I'll take full responsibility!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nuhuhu! We got praised by the staff! 
This is surely an omen that our final 
episode will end in great fortune!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm really glad to hear that. ...If we 
were able to show the viewers 
just how important it is to 'convey' one's 
feelings, that is.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I need to 'convey' mine too. 
To Taiki... and to Fukukitaru as well.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my?! C-Could this be about 
Valentine's Day?! 
It's a night parade of a hundred happy 
spirits!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nuhu... Truth be told, I'm actually in the 
middle of preparing 
something for Valentine's Day for you and 
the others, Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You two are the vital, precious sources of 
my daily happiness! 
Just talking with you makes me feel so 
incredibly lucky...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...The feeling is mutual. All things 
considered, 
I couldn't even begin to count all the 
times I've been glad to have you both 
around.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Then we absolutely must exchange our daily 
gratitude on Valentine's Day! 
It's bound to fill us with a powerful wave 
of good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...That is surely a "mutef." 
If a "connect" is established.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However... the "orbit" toward the 
"connect." 
That is――Neo Universe is also in a state 
of "trouble."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
(Conveying the "vector" of one's own 
"feelings." 
That is likely "possible.")

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
(However――to "connect" with the same 
"magnitude," the same "weight"...)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...What Neo Universe "seeks"――is not here.
